      • assign

        public static <S extends FieldValueProvider,D extends FieldValueSetter> void assign(S source,
                                                                                    TypedField<S> sourceField,
                                                                                    D dest,
                                                                                    TypedField<D> destField)
        Assigns a value from a source field another field. The data transfer is faster in some situations (for the moment: when both instances are backed by FO) as simply use getter and setter methods to transfer the field values.
        Type Parameters:
        S - Source type.
        D - Destination type.
        Parameters:
        source - The source instance where the field value is copied from.
        sourceField - Source fields name
        dest - The destination instance where the field value is copied to.
        destField - Destination fields name
